Solara — (9.4) QUASAR

SPACE RAVEN

"Space raven, space raven"

[Verse 1]

The dive bar at Level Twenty-Nine

Had seen a lot of things

But it had not seen this

Fourteen people

One Seraphim still holding torn pages

One captain who did not know she was a captain

All trying to explain

Cassie went first

She said: your name is SOLARA

She said: you are the captain of this crew

She said: we have been together since NOVA

SOLARA said: what is NOVA

Cassie said: it is how we started

SOLARA said: hm

[Pre-Chorus]

Persy said: I am Persy

He said: we have been through Level Thirty-Four together

He said: we fought a bee kingdom

He said: you were not there but you would have loved it

SOLARA said: a bee kingdom

Persy said: yes

SOLARA said: hm

[Chorus]

Space raven, space raven

Somewhere in this crew is the person you were

Space raven, space raven

We have been looking for you since the hollow turned bright

We know your name

We know your mission

We know every level you have walked

Space raven come back to us

We are right here

We have always been right here

[Verse 2]

Rion said: I am Rion

He said: the Hunter

He said: Persy and I do not know each other’s names for a long time and then we did

He said: it is actually a funny story

SOLARA said: okay

Rion said: do you want to hear it

SOLARA said: not particularly

Cygnus did not say anything

He danced one small step

Just to see if she would react

She watched him

She said: that is nice

Cygnus stopped

Herc said: I am Herc

He said: I strangled a lion

He said: I have the hide if you want to see it

SOLARA said: I am okay

Aldric said: I am undead

He said: I have been undead for a significant amount of time

He said: I have maps from my undead state that are relevant to the current situation

SOLARA looked at him

For the first time

With what might have been interest

She said: maps of what

He said: negative forty-five

She said: hm

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Chaos said: I am Chaos

He said: perhaps you have heard of me

He said: the bounty is one billion star coins

He said: that is a lot of star coins

SOLARA said: yes it is

Chaos seemed pleased

Disorder said: do not encourage him

Disorder said: I am Disorder

Disorder said: he is with me

Chaos said: she is with me

Mayhem said: we are Mayhem Havoc and Ruin

Ruin said: combined

Havoc said: together

Mayhem knocked something over

By accident

On purpose

[Bridge]

It landed on the bar

A raven

Not from this level

Not from this fold

The kind of raven that does not arrive by accident

It looked at SOLARA

SOLARA looked at it

The whole bar went quiet

It walked across the bar

It stepped onto her hand

She did not pull away

She had not pulled away from anything since Level Twenty-Nine

But this was different

She looked at the raven

The raven looked at her

Something moved

Behind her eyes

Something that had been very far away

Coming slightly closer

She said:

Who is Pandora and Elara

Nobody answered right away

[Final Chorus]

Space raven, space raven

Something in you still remembers

Space raven, space raven

Deeper than the level that tried to take it

We know your name

We know your mission

We know every level you have walked

But you just found something

We did not tell you

Space raven

You are already looking

[Outro]

Lara wrote it down

She wrote: the raven came from nowhere

She wrote: she asked about two names

She wrote: she knew to ask

She stopped

She looked at the raven

The raven looked at her

She added: she knew to ask
